Detectives,

[p align="initial"]We just released a patch for MOUSE: P.I. For Hire on Steam! Patch v1.2.2 introduces a range of bug fixes and improvements, addressing gameplay, progression, stability, UI, localisation, controls/input, and other issues. Some of the fixes include correcting instances of the collectibles display shelf not properly updating after Level Revisits, pathfinding issues with the Robo-Betty boss fight, and several crashes relating to the lockpicking minigame. This patch is out now.
[p align="initial"]
[p align="initial"]Check out the full Patch Notes below!
[p align="initial"]Thank you so much for your continued support, especially our recent physical launch and addition of Level Revists! We cannot wait to share more of what is to come in the future.
[p align="initial"]
[p align="initial"]We are cheesed to have met you!
[p align="initial"]
[p align="initial"]Patch v1.2.2
[p align="initial"]Build ID: 24348457
[p align="initial"]Gameplay and Progression
[p align="initial"]Fixed some instances of side quests being unable to be completed when revisiting ‘River Fever Line’, where NPC’s show ongoing dialogue but quests would not register.
[p align="initial"]Fixed a progression issue where certain pipes could not be interacted with after players spoke with the Old Shrew NPC in ‘The Depths’.
[p align="initial"]Fixed an issue where players could jump over a fence and roam freely while the camera remained active in ‘Clergy Row’.
[p align="initial"]Fixed a pathfinding issue with Robo-Betty where the boss became permanently stuck in a running loop, allowing players to bypass the third encounter.
[p align="initial"]Fixed issues with the display shelf in Jack Pepper’s office failing to properly update after collectibles were picked up during Level Revisits.
[p align="initial"]Fixed a blocker where rapidly accepting newspaper popups could accidentally close the shop window and lock players out of the UI, requiring a game restart.: [p align="initial"]
[p align="initial"]UI and Menus
[p align="initial"]Fixed incorrect positioning of the ‘Exit Level’ and ‘Exit Game’ options in the pause menu.
[p align="initial"]Fixed instances of the ‘Exit Level’ option not being selectable in the pause menu.
[p align="initial"]Controls and Input

[p align="initial"]Improved key rebinding functionality across all platforms and input methods, with all actions now able to be rebound (excluding the “Use” action on controllers, which shares an input with “Reload” and cannot be rebound due to hardware limitations).

Detectives,

We just released our biggest update yet for MOUSE: P.I. For Hire on Steam. Update v1.2.1 introduces the highly requested Level Revisit feature, which provides the ability to replay previously completed levels, allowing you to grab any missing collectibles and finish incomplete side quests! Additionally, we have implemented several quality of life improvements, including Uncapped Variable Refresh Rate (VRR), performance optimizations throughout the game, full support for ultrawide (21:9) and super ultrawide (32:9) monitors on PC, enhancements to the Weapon Wheel, horizontal axis inversion, and improvements to both settings menu navigation and controller rebinding. Bug fixes are also plentiful, addressing a range of stability concerns with gameplay, saves, graphics, audio, and progression. The team has also continued to resolve issues regarding weapons, combat, UI, menus, questing, and performance. Check out the full Update Notes below!

Thank you to everybody who has supported MOUSE: P.I. For Hire, from our day 1 players to those jumping into the game with our upcoming physical launch! We are absolutely not done yet, so please follow our channels for more updates in the future.
Say cheese!
Update v1.2.1
Build ID: 24068822
ALL PLATFORMS
Features and Quality of Life Improvements
Level Revisit - Replay previous levels to collect missing collectibles and finish incomplete side quests.
This feature is accessible via the overworld map by simply driving to a completed level and selecting “Revisit”.
Completing the game will now automatically transport you to the HUB zone after the credits roll, providing access to the overworld map to replay levels.

For players who have already completed the game, select “Continue” or reload your latest save file in the Main Menu, which will transport you to the HUB zone and provide access to the overworld map to replay levels.
Uncapped VRR - Variable Refresh Rate support for smoother gameplay on compatible displays.
Performance Optimization - General performance and optimization pass across the game.
Weapon Wheel Upgrade Display - Weapon upgrade levels now displayed on the Weapon Wheel.
Weapon Wheel Visual Uplift - Improved visual states and readability on the Weapon Wheel.
Horizontal Axis Inversion - Added horizontal axis inversion option to camera controls.
Settings Menu Improvements - "Apply" prompt now only appears when changes are actually made.
Audio Feedback for Settings - Added audio confirmation when applying settings changes.
Control Rebinding Overhaul - Improved reliability and usability of the control rebinding system.
Kick Tutorial Failsafe - Players who missed the kick tutorial in 'Vaudeville' will no longer get stuck in later levels.

Detectives,
We just released our biggest Patch yet for MOUSE: P.I. For Hire on Steam.

This update implements a range of quality of life improvements, including Alpha Widescreen support on PC, improved performance and optimization, full Flashlight rebinding, updated ammo placement, and changes to unlock requirements for specific achievements (which includes retroactive unlocks for players who already met these requirements). Bug fixes are also plentiful, such as removing sound distortion in menus, fixing crashes, addressing blockers, and many more. This Patch is out now, so check out the Patch Notes below!
Gouda-bye!
Patch v1.1.0
Build ID: 23336178
Quality of Life
Improved performance and optimization pass across the game.
The Flashlight is now rebindable across all platforms.
Updated the unlock requirements for the following achievements and implemented retroactive unlocks for players who have already met these for:
‘Misfortunes of the Missing Magician’
‘Smoked Cheese and Mirrors’
‘Burdens of Blue Betty’
‘Tinsel Boulevard’
‘Secrets of the Shrew Shortage’
‘Our Lesser Brothers’
Players can no longer unintentionally skip acquiring the following:
Double Jump in the ‘Mouseburg Opera’ level
Grappling Tail in the ‘Tinsel Ave’ level
Portable Freezer in the ‘Bandel’s Mansion’ level
The Detective Brush (directional helper) in ‘Fart Harbor’ has now been updated to better highlight the path to the player.
The Film Grain Effect setting now correctly works in-game.
Updated ammo placement across levels.
Adjusted the damage rate, projectile timings, cooldowns and spawn rate of enemies for the final boss fight in the ‘Curdsville' level.
Added a direct link to the MOUSE: P.I. For Hire Discord and Customer Support Website in the Main Menu.
Bug Fixes
General
Swapping to the Portable Freezer and shooting before the swapping animation finishes will no longer have the chance to crash the game.
Improved save handling to ensure the game does not incorrectly crash when attempting to load a corrupted save.
Fixed several crashes that could occur when entering and exiting levels.
Resolved an issue where D-Namite could appear invisible as the player attempts to throw it.
Resolved an issue where quick-throwing D-Namite could result in the player being blown up.
Multiple newspapers can now be purchased from the store in the ‘P.I. Office’ level without the game freezing.
Resolved an issue where the player could get stuck when trying to exit the area in the room with the first Save Point in the 'Der Harzerburg' level.
Fixed an issue where doors could incorrectly re-open in ‘Vaudeville’ when the player reloads saves.
Compass marker now updates correctly after pinning all collected clues from the ‘Vaudeville’ level.
The miniboss ‘Brawn Hilda’ now paths correctly in the arena in the ‘Mouseburg Opera’ Level.
Removed a blocker in the ‘Clergyrow’ level, where doors would not open when entering through the secret entrance on the side of the building.
Resolved an issue where some doors would not open on the 'Tinsel Ave.’ level following a previous hotfix update.
The player will now only be able to enter the Keyboard Rebinding Settings if a keyboard is connected.
Resolved an issue where the player could be softlocked during the Baseball Minigame and the game would not accept any input.
The player will now be able to correctly enter and exit the Baseball Minigame during the banning phase and not enter a state where they are locked out of re-entering the minigame.
Resolved an issue where laser attacks would persist after defeating the boss in ‘Bandel’s Laboratory' level.
The boss in ‘The Old Subway’ level will no longer collide with the gate when entering the arena, ensuring the gameplay camera can now be used correctly by the player.
Updated collisions in the ‘Wallop Bay’ level that could result in the player being stuck in geometry.
Removed an invisible teleport point that players may trigger in the ‘Curdsville Nuthouse’ nuthouse level.
Fixed an issue where enemies could get stuck during the drawbridge arena in the ‘Quagmire’ level if enemies were killed too close to spawning doors.
Resolved an issue where riding the elevator in ‘The Depths’ could softlock the game.
Removed an invisible collision from vents in the ‘Western Backlot’ level that could result in the player being stuck.
Fixed various points that the player could be softlocked by entering different rooms in the ‘Curdsville Nuthouse’ level.
Player will no longer be softlocked when reloading a save in the ‘Secret Show’ level wherein the quest would not trigger.
The player can now drink a Health Bottle or eat Cheese while holding quest items, such as in the 'Tinsel Ave.' and ‘River Fever Line’ levels.
All shields will now appear correctly when fighting ‘Ze Professor’ boss in the ‘Fart Harbor’ level.
Fixed music not playing correctly across the ‘Bandel’s Mansion' level.
Removed a white flash that appears on screen when skipping the cutscene during the final boss fight in the ‘Der Harzerbug’ level.
Resolved an issue where the player could not eat Cheese during the final boss fight in the ‘Der Harzerburg’ level if the player held the maximum number of Cheese.
Shotgun enemies throughout the game will now correctly deal damage to the player.
Resolved the sound distortion that can occur across various in-game menu sliders.
The compass will no longer appear backwards on the HUD.
The player will now no longer have the chance to get stuck when talking to NPCs across the game.
The player will no longer be able to rebind multiple movement actions to the same input.
The player will no longer be able to enter a softlock state when exiting the Crime Wall in some cases.
When exiting the Key Rebinding screen, if the player did not save, it will now default to the previous settings.
The Notebook will no longer appear empty when re-booting the game if the language is set to Traditional Chinese.
Fixed an issue where the player could become invincible after cutscenes end.
Fixed various occlusion issues across levels where the player could see out of the world.
Fixed various collision issues across all levels where the player could fall out of world.
Quests
The player will now correctly see the icon directing them to the ‘P.I. Office’ level when required to pin clues onto the Crime Wall.
Quest Items and NPC’s will no longer disappear when restarting the ‘Fart Harbor’ level.
When collecting the Hellrazor in the ‘???’ level, the gate to progress will now always open.
The Carnival Vendor for the dynamite minigame in the ‘Secret Show’ level now always appears correctly, allowing the player to progress through the level.
The ‘Explore the Mansion’ Quest in the ‘Far Wetlands’ level now correctly clears from the quest log once the objectives are met.
The player will no longer be potentially trapped in the Sewer’s Room while completing the ‘Shrewd Shrews' Quest in ‘The Depths’ level.
The ‘Give Chase’ quest objective now correctly clears after completing the ‘Western Backlot’ level.
The ‘Hold your nose and cross the quagmire' quest objective now correctly clears after the player meets the conditions in the ‘Quagmire’ level.
The ‘Get your stash from Little & Big' quest objective now correctly clears after the player meets the conditions in the ‘Burned Office’ level.
The player will now always be able to interact with the door after defeating the ‘Judge Fatale' miniboss in 'The Reel Deal’ level and continue the quest.
The ‘To Catch a Mockingmouse’ quest now correctly triggers after handing in the Quest Item to the NPC in the ‘River Fever Line’ level.
The 'Friends in Deep Places' side quest is now completable if the player restarts the level.
Side quest indicators for ‘Poster Girl' and ‘Behind the Nuts’ will no longer be missing when in the 'P.I. Office’ level.
Platform Specific Changes
PC
Implemented Alpha Widescreen support for PC platforms. Players will now be able to play MOUSE: P.I. For Hire in widescreen.

Note: This is an Alpha Feature as weapons and first-person animations are still hand-drawn for a 16:9 frame, so there may be a hard edge visible for some weapons and animation sprites. To support ultrawide in full without these drawbacks, every weapon and animation will need to be redrawn to properly scale to the ultrawide perspective, and this will take some time.
Fixed an issue where changing movement bindings would not update when driving Jack’s car around the Mouseburg Overworld and in the Lockpicking Minigame.
The default Field of View (FOV) value is now set to 90 on PC Handhelds, instead of 105.

Fixes & Improvements
Resolved a graphical issue in “The Reel Deal” that could previously prevent players from progressing due to a black screen when lens distortion is disabled.

Refined a small number of Simplified Chinese translations for better accuracy.
Addressed a bug where shotgun-wielding enemies would occasionally fail to deal damage to the player.
